package: Wanderful App Store Release Package V1
repository_policy: This is a bounded unanswered template. Record decisions and evidence in the authorized release system; do not place credentials, private account data, tax records or signing material in git.

decisions.required_evidence: Active Apple Developer Program legal entity, Team ID, Account Holder, authorized release operator, current agreements and any applicable paid-app tax/banking prerequisites, verified in the authorized release system.
Verified App Store Connect record, approved Wanderful name and rights, primary language, immutable SKU and exact com.trailmind.app mapping.
Approved legal controller and policy content plus a reachable canonical public HTTPS URL matching the in-app URL and App Store Connect value.
Monitored support contact, responsible operator/legal details and a reachable canonical public HTTPS support page.
Owner-approved answers reconciled with the selected archive, embedded SDK manifests, production backend linkage, logging, retention and live policy.
Completed current App Store Connect age-rating questionnaire with owner or counsel approval; no inferred rating is accepted.
Legal or security classification of the final binary and recorded App Store Connect export answers and documentation, if required.
Rights inventory for product name, icon, onboarding art, code and exact map, routing, elevation and data sources plus the App Store declaration.
Owner-approved primary and optional secondary categories matching the selected build and any regulated-device declarations.
Approved price or free availability, storefront territories and truthful route/backend coverage boundary.
Authorized TestFlight groups and manual, automatic or phased release strategy, selected only after prerequisite gates pass.
Explicit V1 exclusion approval or separately proved products, purchase flow, disclosures, privacy answers and App Review configuration.
Approved backend owner, canonical HTTPS endpoint, retention and deletion rules, logging, rate limits, deployed flags, provider authority and App Attest enforcement.
Owner-approved metadata, screenshot localization/device set and voice-marketing scope reconciled to the exact selected build and physical-device proof.
